mapper.select: SELECT * FROM td_data_resource WHERE source_path = #{sourcePath} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.resource_id, r.resource_name, r.resource_type, r.org_id, r.org_name, r.datasource_id, r.source_path, r.description, r.tags, r.status, r.field_count, COALESCE(r.record_count, CASE WHEN c.reltuples > 0 THEN c.reltuples::bigint ELSE NULL END) AS record_count, r.last_sync_time, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time FROM td_data_resource r LEFT JOIN pg_namespace nsp ON nsp.nspname = CASE WHEN r.source_path LIKE '%.%' THEN SPLIT_PART(r.source_path, '.', 1) ELSE 'public' END LEFT JOIN pg_class c ON c.relnamespace = nsp.oid AND c.relname = SPLIT_PART(r.source_path, '.', 2) AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm') WHERE r.datasource_id = #{datasourceId} ORDER BY r.resource_name
SELECT * FROM td_data_resource ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM td_data_resource WHERE resource_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR description ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR source_path ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY resource_name
